title: Compatible affine étale covering systems with every Čech intersection
statement: For a scheme Y [def-pc-scheme], a pro-étale Y-object V, a finite family U indexed by Fin n over V, and a small category I, an AffineEtaleCechSystem consists of étale covering families T(i,a)→W(i), affine nonempty repeated intersections, functorial transition maps between these intersections, and cone legs from the corresponding original intersection. The cone legs are natural and both they and transitions commute with every omitted-factor map. Its nerve and nerveCone are the associated diagram and cone. No limit property is included in this data type.
